notes.title: v0.4.0 Update Notes (June 14, 2025): "Nightshadow" Makes Debut
notes.content:
[h2]New Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added melee character "Nightshadow"
[*] Nightshadow AI player available
[*] Added screen indicators for some skills
[*] Added a new skill introduction UI
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Charging time of Preparatory Knight's E skill: 0.5S → 0.3S
[*] Damage of Archery Maid's aerial heavy attack damage: 13 → 17
[*] Increased the jump distance of Archery Maid's E skill
[*] Killing in Duel Mode no longer refreshes Flash
[*] Distinguished the sound effects of light attack charging and heavy attack charging
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations/Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized some attack sound effects and special effects of Aurgold Master
[*] Optimized the special effect performance of Perfect Defense
[*] Optimized part of the performance of ranged attacks
[*] Optimized the visual performance of the Invincibility effect
[*] Optimized the camera effect of Knight's R skill
[*] Optimized the performance of characters
[*] Optimized the AI logic for targets in grass
[*] Fixed some visual issues in Horizon Heaven
[*] Fixed the problem of Flash passing through walls in Training Map and Tutorial Map
[*] Fixed some BUGs caused by steps
[*] Fixed the display error of the Stamina Ring during initialization
[*] Fixed the multi-segment damage problem of Aurgold Master's charged light attack
[*] Fixed some spectator perspective issues
[*] Fixed the problem of sometimes falling out of the map after eliminated
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.1 Update Note
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Key binding adjustment function
[*] Added debug function to unlock ultimate camera lock
[*] Aurgold Master can now use the scroll wheel to switch Cube modes at any time
[*] Added function to modify double-click time (for step)
[*] Added video and graphics adjustment settings
[*] Added more detailed sound effect category volume settings
[*] The game will now automatically set graphics quality based on device performance when first launched
[/list]

[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Knight's Sword Aura knockback height: 1000 → 600
[*] Knight's Sword Aura cooldown time: 1.2s → 2s
[*] Minimum mid-air knockback height: 1200 → 900
[*] Cheat shortcut keys removed
[*] Aurgold Master E skill wind-up time: 0.73s → 0.5s
[*] Aurgold Master E skill cooldown time: 20s → 23s
[*] Aurgold Master Q skill jump armor time: 1s → 0.3s
[*] Hide UI function moved to the settings interface
[/list]

[b]Optimizations/Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where training ground sandbags lacked landing protection invincibility after knockback
[*] Fixed issue where dwarves couldn't switch Rubik's Cube modes in the training ground
[*] Optimized Maid R skill knockback
[*] Optimized partial display in the settings interface
[*] Optimized stamina update logic
[*] Fixed issue where spectating real players wouldn't automatically switch players when eliminated
[*] Fixed issue where Knight's ultimate could be interrupted by self and cast infinitely
[*] Fixed issue where early spectators join in 1v1 matches caused game progression errors
[*] Fixed issue where sandbags didn't react to freeze and stun effects
[*] Fixed issue where Aurgold Master Q could trigger on landing even when interrupted
[*] Optimized mid-air state judgment logic
[*] Fixed issue where perfectly blocking mid-air attacks caused airborne effects
[*] Optimized Dwarf E skill casting position determination logic
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 0.3.0. The new ranged character "Archery Maid"
notes.content:
New Additions:
- New ranged character "Archery Maid"
- The AI will now use 3 characters
- In custom rooms, BOT players can be added, and their difficulty level and the characters they use can be set
- There is new music in the training ground and the novice tutorial
- Sound effect prompt for low stamina

Adjustments:
- Display the frame rate in the upper right corner of the game
- The number of shots for the Aurgold Master's charged left-click hammer is limited to 5 times
- The energy return for the Aurgold Master's ultimate when it misses is increased from 50% to 75%
- The practical operation of perfect defense is removed from the novice tutorial
- The AI difficulty in the final actual combat part of the novice tutorial is reduced
- The charging time for the Aurgold Master's right-click is adjusted from 1.66s to 1.44s
- "Above City" is temporarily removed from the map list

Optimizations/Fixes:
- Optimize the display of knockback smoke (so that it doesn't block the character)
- Fix the issue where a character still flies out when frozen by the dwarf's magic cube
- Fix the issue where the Aurgold Master takes damage from its own magic cube
- Fix the issue where using flash makes the character get stuck in the ground
- Optimize the flash logic, and now it can pass through walls
- Fix the issue where the HP value information is wrongly hidden during spectator mode
- Fix the issue where the logic of the grass hiding characters is incorrect during spectator mode
- Optimize the screen vibration feedback during attacks
- Fix the issue where the game can't end properly when the last life commits suicide in the duel mode
- Optimize the AI's combat logic
- Fix some floating issues

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 0.2.2 on January 22, 2025
notes.content:
Hello, players! Duel Paean has a new update! Here's what we have for you this time:

[list]
[*]New English language support, making it convenient for players from all over the world to experience the game.
[*]A brand new human-AI mode, allowing you to play the game more quickly.
[*]Optimized beginner tutorials to help you get started easily.
[*]A dedicated training camp for targeted skill improvement.
[*]A mid-game spectating function, so you don't miss out on exciting matches.
[*]A new spectating perspective, bringing a new visual experience.
[/list]

Thank you all for your continuous attention and support. We will keep working hard to make the game even better! If you have any comments or suggestions, feel free to leave a message in the community.
